source_text: {An important example is the \emph{simplicial chain complex} associated to a triangulation or more general simplicial complex. The dimensions of its homology spaces are the Betti numbers of the underlying space.}
translated_text: {一个重要例子是与剖分或更一般的单纯复形相伴的\emph{单纯链复形}. 它的同调空间的维数是底空间的 Betti 数.}
{由此产生\emph{闭上链}, \emph{上边界链}与\emph{上同调}.}

source_text: {The dual spaces and dual maps of a chain complex form a cochain complex.}
translated_text: {链复形的对偶空间和对偶映射构成一个上链复形.}

source_text:
{The de Rham map is a \emph{cochain map} from the de Rham complex to the dual of the simplicial chain complex and, as such, induces a map on cohomology. De Rham's theorem states that the induced map is an isomorphism.}
\end{tcolorbox}
translated_text:
{de Rham 映射是从 de Rham 复形到单纯链复形的对偶复形的一个\emph{上链映射}, 因而在上同调上诱导一个映射. De Rham 定理断言, 这一诱导映射是同构.}
